= Link bracket substitutions
:name: Expanded
:source-highlighter: syntect

pass:m[link:https://example.org[One \\] two\]]

pass:q,m[link:https://example.org[*One \\] two*\]]

pass:a,m[link:https://example.org[{name} \\] tail\]]

pass:m,a[link:https://example.org[{name} \\] tail\]]

[subs=macros]
link:https://example.org[One \] two]

[subs=-macros]
link:https://example.org[Literal \] text]

[source,rust,subs=+macros]
----
let label = link:https://example.org[One \] two];
let mail = mailto:test@example.org[Mail \] label];
----

----
link:https://example.org[Literal \] text]
----
